messages.subject: Somewhat conceptual question about "explanatory IRT"
parts:
Hi All, 

Please anyone feel free to field this one, or Phil, tell me to take it elsewhere. 

Given a mixedmirt model, "explanatory IRT," informative item characteristics should not only yield informative coefficients about items and characteristics, but any estimated person scores would have more precision.

Assuming the previous, what are the limitations of the "item characteristics matrix"? Has there been any work done there? E.g., intercorrelations, number of them. 
Second, does the model have the potential to shift the meaning of person scores dramatically? 

Thanks!
